items.question: How do multiple teeth implants work?
items.answer: Multiple teeth implants use strategically placed titanium implants to support crowns or bridges, replacing several missing teeth with a secure and natural-looking restoration.

items.question: Are multiple teeth implants better than removable dentures?
items.answer: Yes. They provide greater stability, improved chewing ability, enhanced comfort, and help preserve jawbone health compared to removable dentures.
